scale.prompt_suffix: Not at all, a little, somewhat, mostly, or completely?

scoring_notes: Two dimensions, Anxiety and Avoidance, each the mean of 8 items on 1-5 after reversing negative-polarity items (6 minus answer). Midpoint 3.0 splits low/high. Style: low/low secure, high anxiety + low avoidance anxious, low anxiety + high avoidance avoidant, high/high fearful_avoidant. Each dimension has 4 close-relationship items and 4 work-collaboration items so the report can speak to both contexts. See scoring.ts.

items.text: I worry that the people I'm close to don't care about me as much as I care about them.
When someone I love goes distant, I can't settle until I know we're okay.
I rarely worry about being left by my partner or close friends.
I need more reassurance than most people that I'm valued.
If a teammate takes a while to reply, I start wondering if I did something wrong.
I read a lot into a colleague's tone, especially when their feedback is short.
I feel secure about my standing on a team without needing to hear it.
Being left out of a meeting or a thread stings more than I'd like to admit.
I prefer not to depend on anyone, including a partner.
I get uncomfortable when someone wants to be very emotionally close to me.
It's easy for me to open up about what I'm feeling to the people I love.
When things get intense, my instinct is to pull back and handle it alone.
I'd rather struggle through a problem alone than ask a teammate for help.
I keep work relationships strictly professional and keep my inner life out of them.
I'm comfortable telling a colleague when I'm struggling with something.
When a project gets emotionally charged, I check out and just do the task.
